title: Amazing Bouncy Croatian Umeboshi Skillet
description: A romantic Croatian dish featuring umeboshi, this skillet is perfect for a special occasion, with its combination of umami flavors and bouncy texture.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in an iron teppan skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the sliced Croatian sausage and cook until it is browned.
Add the pitted umeboshi plums, chicken broth, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Stir the mixture to combine and bring it to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use a bain-marie to keep the skillet at a safe temperature.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
